{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module OAuthCache where

import Data.IORef
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import Data.Char (toLower)
import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar, forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Exception (bracket, finally, SomeException, catch)
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

type SessionStore = TVar (Map.Map String SessionData)
type CachePool = MVar [CacheConn]

data CacheConn = CacheConn
  { connId :: Int
  , connAlive :: IORef Bool
  }

data SessionData = SessionData
  { sdToken :: String
  , sdRedirectUri :: String
  , sdState :: String
  , sdScopes :: [String]
  } deriving (Show)

data OAuthConfig = OAuthConfig
  { allowedHosts :: [String]
  , allowedSchemes :: [String]
  , clientId :: String
  , maxRedirectLen :: Int
  }

defaultConfig :: OAuthConfig
defaultConfig = OAuthConfig
  { allowedHosts = ["app.example.com", "auth.example.com"]
  , allowedSchemes = ["https"]
  , clientId = "client_abc123"
  , maxRedirectLen = 2048
  }

-- Parse URI into (scheme, authority, path, query)
parseUri :: String -> Maybe (String, String, String, String)
parseUri uri =
  case break (== ':') uri of
    (scheme, ':':'/':'/':rest) ->
      let (authority, pathAndQuery) = break (\c -> c == '/' || c == '?') rest
          (path, query) = break (== '?') pathAndQuery
      in Just (map toLower scheme, map toLower authority, path, query)
    _ -> Nothing

-- Normalize the redirect URI for validation
normalizeRedirect :: String -> String
normalizeRedirect uri =
  let stripped = dropWhile (== ' ') uri
      -- Remove any embedded whitespace/control chars
      cleaned = filter (\c -> c /= '\r' && c /= '\n' && c /= '\t') stripped
  in cleaned

-- Core validation: check if redirect_uri is allowed (exact host match only)
validateRedirectUri :: OAuthConfig -> String -> Bool
validateRedirectUri config rawUri =
  let uri = normalizeRedirect rawUri
  in if length uri > maxRedirectLen config
     then False
     else case parseUri uri of
       Nothing -> False
       Just (scheme, authority, path, _query) ->
         let schemeOk = scheme `elem` allowedSchemes config
             -- Extract host from authority (strip port)
             host = takeWhile (/= ':') authority
             hostOk = host `elem` allowedHosts config
             pathOk = not (".." `isInfixOf` path)
         in schemeOk && hostOk && pathOk

-- Initialize cache connection pool
initPool :: Int -> IO CachePool
initPool n = do
  conns <- mapM (\i -> do
    alive <- newIORef True
    return $ CacheConn i alive) [1..n]
  newMVar conns

-- Graceful shutdown: drain connections
shutdownPool :: CachePool -> IO ()
shutdownPool pool = do
  conns <- takeMVar pool
  mapM_ (\c -> writeIORef (connAlive c) False) conns
  putMVar pool []
  putStrLn "Cache pool shut down gracefully"

-- Store session in distributed cache (simulated)
cacheSession :: CachePool -> String -> SessionData -> IO Bool
cacheSession pool key sd = do
  conns <- takeMVar pool
  case conns of
    [] -> do
      putMVar pool []
      return False
    (c:cs) -> do
      putMVar pool cs
      alive <- readIORef (connAlive c)
      if alive
        then do
          -- Simulate cache write
          putStrLn $ "Cached session " ++ key ++ " on conn " ++ show (connId c)
          -- Return connection to pool
          conns' <- takeMVar pool
          putMVar pool (conns' ++ [c])
          return True
        else return False

-- OAuth authorization endpoint handler
handleAuthorize :: OAuthConfig -> SessionStore -> CachePool -> String -> String -> String -> IO (Either String String)
handleAuthorize config sessions pool redirectUri state scopes = do
  -- Validate redirect URI
  if validateRedirectUri config redirectUri
    then do
      let sd = SessionData
            { sdToken = ""
            , sdRedirectUri = redirectUri
            , sdState = state
            , sdScopes = words scopes
            }
      -- Store in STM session store
      atomically $ do
        store <- readTVar sessions
        writeTVar sessions (Map.insert state sd store)
      -- Also cache for distributed access
      cached <- cacheSession pool ("oauth:" ++ state) sd
      if cached
        then return $ Right $ "Redirect to login with state=" ++ state
        else return $ Left "Cache unavailable"
    else return $ Left "Invalid redirect_uri"

-- OAuth callback handler
handleCallback :: OAuthConfig -> SessionStore -> String -> String -> IO (Either String String)
handleCallback config sessions state code = do
  mSession <- atomically $ do
    store <- readTVar sessions
    return $ Map.lookup state store
  case mSession of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid state parameter"
    Just sd -> do
      -- Issue token and redirect back
      let finalRedirect = sdRedirectUri sd ++ "?code=" ++ code ++ "&state=" ++ state
      return $ Right finalRedirect

-- Main application lifecycle
runApp :: IO ()
runApp = do
  sessions <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  pool <- initPool 5
  let config = defaultConfig
  -- Simulate request
  result <- handleAuthorize config sessions pool
    "https://app.example.com/callback" "random_state_123" "read write"
  case result of
    Left err -> putStrLn $ "Error: " ++ err
    Right msg -> putStrLn msg
  -- Graceful shutdown
  shutdownPool pool
